decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting line was launched only in 2024 with several models and builds on the firm's core automation offer, so management will give it time to reach aspiration levels, especially since the 2023 robots were consolidated into it and the industry's turnover growth provides slack.

The production analysis software is a low-cost digital complement to the firm's plants and lifecycle service, fits the strategy of future-ready automated production, and carries little burden on resources, so it is unlikely to trigger problemistic search or removal.
